title: sorghum pusillum
intro: Sorghum pusillum, commonly known as yellow indiangrass, is a species of grass within the sorghum genus, native to North America. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of yellow indiangrass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. These compounds have been shown to exhibit various pharmacological activities, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
